title: Restricted Temporal Certificate Canonical Admission
purpose: Decide whether the exact closed F-CI21 postimage may advance the restricted canonical source lineage without broadening any qualified claim.
required_gates: G01 live canonical head remains exactly the pinned pre-admission head
G02 candidate remains a strict linear descendant of canonical with zero behind commits
G03 candidate src and reference trees equal the exact closed F-CI21 trees
G04 all F-CI22 qualification commits leave src and reference byte-identical to F-CI21
G05 F-CI21 closed qualified status and closeout identities and decisions remain exact
G06 F-VQ33 remains failed negative evidence and is not used as positive evidence
G07 no default H_budget, no selected application H_budget or universal tolerance, and no nonlinear true-error-bound or shorter-dt monotonicity claim is introduced
G08 hard mass precedence, rollback, WOF42 crop persistence and MR18 accepted-commit receipt preservation remain carried scope
G09 rerun the current F-CI21 source/compile and semantic closeout-readiness gates on the F-CI22 qualification head
G10 qualification artifacts and metadata do not change the candidate production/reference postimage
G11 immediately before promotion reverify canonical head and fast-forward relation; promotion must use force=false
G12 after promotion verify canonical ref equals the promoted qualified closeout head
